action.action-desc: Mrs. Napolitano (for herself, Ms. Johnson of Texas, Ms. Roybal-Allard, Mr. McNerney, Mr. Huffman, Mr. Rouda, Ms. Brownley of California, Mr. Lowenthal, Mr. Vela, Mrs. Torres of California, Mr. Carbajal, Ms. Hill of California, Ms. Titus, Mr. Cisneros, Mr. Harder of California, Ms. Eshoo, Ms. Sánchez, and Mr. Sires) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Natural Resources

form.official-title: To establish a grant program for the funding of water recycling and reuse projects, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Water Recycling Investment and Improvement Act.

section.header: Competitive grant program for the funding of water recycling and reuse projects

subsection.header: Competitive grant program for the funding of water recycling and reuse projects
subsection.text: Section 1602(f) of the Reclamation Wastewater and Groundwater Study and Facilities Act (title XVI of Public Law 102–575; 43 U.S.C. 390h et seq.) is amended by striking paragraphs (2) and (3) and inserting the following:

paragraph.text: When funding projects under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall give funding priority to projects that meet one or more of the following criteria:

subparagraph.text: Projects that are likely to provide a more reliable water supply for States and local governments.
Projects that are likely to increase the water management flexibility and reduce impacts on environmental resources from projects operated by Federal and State agencies.
Projects that are regional in nature.
Projects that provide multiple benefits, including water supply reliability, eco-system benefits, groundwater management and enhancements, and water quality improvements.

subsection.text: Section 1602(g) of the Reclamation Wastewater and Groundwater Study and Facilities Act (title XVI of Public Law 102–575; 43 U.S.C. 390h et seq.) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking if enacted appropriations legislation designates funding to them by name,.

subsection.text: Section 4013 of the WIIN Act (43 U.S.C. 390b(2)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in paragraph (2), by striking the period and inserting ; and; and
by adding at the end the following:

subsection.text: Section 1631(d) of the Reclamation Wastewater and Groundwater Study and Facilities Act (43 U.S.C. 390h–13(d)) is amended by striking $20,000,000 (October 1996 prices) and inserting $30,00,000 (January 2019 prices).
